application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Submission of details of conditions 5 (Refuse collection)  6 (Demolition and Construction Management and Logistics plan) pursuant to planning permission 21/4204/FUL dated 07/07/2026Condition 5 ? Refuse Collection Arrangements: Details of the refuse and recycling storage arrangements as shown on the approved Block Plan 202043.P.3011 Rev E, including the dedicated bin storage enclosure, 3 refuse bins, 3 recycling bins and garden waste provision. The arrangements will be provided before occupation and retained thereafter.Condition 6 ? Demolition and Construction Management and Logistics Plan: A Demolition and Construction Management and Logistics Plan addressing construction vehicle routing, hours of access, site access and egress, site security, recycling of construction materials, on-site storage and delivery areas, vehicle washing and prevention of mud/dirt on the adjoining highway, control of dust, noise and vibration, and provision of a competent banksman.The submitted information is intended to fully satisfy and discharge Conditions 5 and 6 of planning permission 21/4204/FUL.
